scope: All four Chinese essays and every English translation unit, including titles, descriptions and index introduction, were compared directly.
pending_authorial_source_decisions: The original Chinese factual issues listed in en-batch01.json remain pending author review. This pass verifies translation fidelity, not approval of those source assertions.

findings.issue: Comparison range widened from the novel’s monologues to everything in the book.
findings.resolution: Restored the comparison to the monologue sounding least like a villain speaking.

findings.issue: English version of the final two sentences used present-tense paraphrase despite identifying the novel’s final words.
The phrase no room left was too literal and ambiguous for 没有余地.
findings.resolution: Replaced with There is no getting around it.

checks: All original examples, narrative scenes, section order, questions and callbacks are present.
The planned mechanisms of Newspeak, doublethink and the alteration of records remain distinct.
The reality of an event is not reduced to the survival of its records or witnesses.
Sincere betrayal under torture is not described as an unconstrained free choice.
The appendix’s grammatical clues are not converted into proof of the regime’s fall.
The author’s later stronger philosophical judgment about all remains a stronger judgment, without an invented proof or an unrequested retraction.
